engineering_interpretation: This table defines the control parameters and commands for the rear left door lamp's fade speed, on/off state, color, and brightness within the Interior Lighting Sub System. It is used to verify that the lamp responds correctly to various input signals and timing constraints as specified in the Z-ONE-3.0 platform.
